title: Diagonal dimension and intermediate sub-C*-algebras
summary: We show that finiteness of diagonal dimension, in the sense of Li--Liao--Winter, passes to intermediate sub-C*-algebras. More specifically, we obtain an upper bound for the diagonal dimension of the pair of an intermediate sub-C*-algebra in a C*-diagonal together with the diagonal, which we estimate in terms of the diagonal dimension of the ambient pair and the covering dimension of the diagonal's spectrum. This generalizes a theorem of Archbold and Kumjian stating that intermediate sub-C*-algebras of AF-diagonals are AF C*-algebras.
